prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you want (UV beds vs spray tans, budget, distance, atmosphere). I can look up current top-rated salons near you — tell me your Columbus neighborhood or ZIP and whether you want spray/no-UV or sunbed tanning — and I’ll pull a short list with addresses, ratings and why each one’s recommended.

Meanwhile, quick guidance on choosing the best salon:
- Decide spray (safer, immediate results) or UV (beds): many people prefer spray tans to avoid UV damage.
- Read recent reviews (last 6–12 months) on Google and Yelp for cleanliness, consistency and customer service.
- Check credentials: trained technicians for spray tans; up-to-date, well-maintained equipment for beds.
- Ask about products (airbrush solutions, organic options), prep and aftercare instructions, and patch tests.
- Compare pricing, first-time specials and memberships.
- Look for photos of actual client results, not stock images.

Safety reminders:
- Prefer spray tans or use sunscreen if avoiding UV exposure.
- If you use tanning beds, follow recommended exposure times, wear eye protection, and avoid tanning if you’re on photosensitizing medication or have a history of skin cancer.
- Moisturize and exfoliate as directed to get an even tan and avoid streaking.

If you want, give me your ZIP or neighborhood and whether you prefer spray or UV and I’ll find top-rated options in Columbus.
